landing.reviews.item_2_description: Test broader silhouettes and darker areas to identify useful directions for a cover-up specialist.

landing.faq.title: Everything you need to know about Tattoo Generator
landing.faq.q_1: What is Tattoo Generator and how does it work?
landing.faq.a_1: Describe the meaning, style, placement, and details you want. The tattoo agent develops the concept, generates a visual, and helps you refine it through follow-up messages.
landing.faq.q_2: Is Tattoo Generator free to use?
landing.faq.a_2: After you sign up, you may receive trial credits under the current trial offer. Check your account for the available balance and expiry details.
landing.faq.q_3: How is Tattoo Generator different from a generic image generator?
landing.faq.a_3: The experience is organized around tattoo decisions such as style, placement, line weight, composition, and revision history.
landing.faq.q_4: What tattoo styles can I explore?
landing.faq.a_4: Fine line, botanical, American traditional, blackwork, geometric, lettering, and many hybrid styles can all be explored.
landing.faq.q_5: How does Tattoo Generator protect my privacy?
landing.faq.a_5: You can review our Privacy Policy for information about how your data is handled. Contact support with privacy questions or data deletion requests.
landing.faq.q_6: Can I use the generated images commercially?
landing.faq.a_6: Before using a design commercially, review the service terms and the usage terms of the model you chose. Make sure you have the necessary rights to the design and any reference images you upload.
landing.faq.q_7: Are there any limitations to using Tattoo Generator?
landing.faq.a_7: Generating images uses credits, with costs depending on the model you choose. Your available balance and any current upload restrictions affect what you can create.
landing.faq.q_8: Do I need to create an account to use Tattoo Generator?
landing.faq.a_8: Yes. An account is needed to create and save designs, keep your conversations, and track your credit balance. Use the sign-in options currently shown on the site.
landing.faq.q_9: Is Tattoo Generator available on mobile devices?
landing.faq.a_9: Tattoo Generator is a responsive web app that works on phones, tablets, and desktop browsers.
landing.faq.q_10: How can I provide feedback or report issues?
landing.faq.a_10: Sign in and use the support button on this site, or submit a ticket from your account. Describe the issue and include any relevant screenshots.

admin.settings.tips.default_llm_provider: Auto uses OpenAI when its API key is set, otherwise Anthropic. Credentials come from the provider cards below.
admin.settings.tips.agent_model: Model id as the chosen provider names it. Required for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, which all name models differently.
admin.settings.tips.openai_base_url: Include the version segment — the client appends /chat/completions.
admin.settings.tips.anthropic_base_url: Host only — the client appends /v1/messages. Gateways expose this protocol on their own path (gRouter: /api/anthropic).
admin.settings.tips.adsense_code: Your AdSense publisher ID — also used to generate /ads.txt
admin.settings.tips.creem_product_ids_ma: Map the product_id in pricing catalog to the product ID created in Creem. Must be a valid JSON object.
admin.settings.tips.default_image_provid: Auto prefers gRouter when it is configured, then Replicate, then Fal. Applies to both text-to-image and image editing.
admin.settings.tips.google_one_tap_enabl: Show the Google One Tap prompt to signed-out visitors. Requires Client ID.
admin.settings.tips.grouter_model_map: Optional JSON mapping the picker model key to the route name configured in your gateway. Defaults to the key itself (e.g. gpt-image-2).
admin.settings.tips.plausible_domain: Optional for the new site-specific script; required by legacy scripts
admin.settings.tips.plausible_src: Paste the complete site-specific script URL from Plausible, or leave blank to use the legacy cloud script
admin.settings.tips.r2_endpoint: Leave empty to use the default R2 endpoint
admin.settings.tips.r2_upload_path: Path to upload files to; leave empty to use the default. Example: uploads/foo/bar
admin.settings.tips.signup_ip_daily_limi: Caps how many accounts one address may open in 24 hours, so the signup credit grant cannot be farmed. 0 disables the cap; blank uses the default of 5.
admin.settings.tips.grouter_base_url: A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible image gateway. Leave the whole group blank unless you run one.
